business.name: NorthSide Precast Block Walls
business.tagline: Engineered precast concrete block walls, installed fast.
business.about: We supply and install 600 x 600 x 1200 precast concrete blocks for structural walls across Mount Kuring-gai and Sydney’s North. Our modular, stackable blocks are engineered for strength, stability, and speed of installation, making them ideal for retaining walls, material bays, boundaries, and temporary or permanent structures. Minimal site preparation, no curing delays, and a focus on safety and reliability mean your wall goes up quickly and stays put.

faqs.q: What size precast concrete blocks do you use?
faqs.a: We primarily work with 600 x 600 x 1200 precast concrete blocks that are engineered for structural performance and modular stacking.
We are based in Mount Kuring-gai, NSW and regularly service Mount Colah, Berowra, Hornsby, Asquith, Wahroonga, the Upper North Shore, and wider Sydney Metro by arrangement.

faqs.q: How fast can a precast block wall be installed?
faqs.a: Because there is no curing time, many small retaining or storage bay walls can be installed within a day once site preparation and access are confirmed.

faqs.q: Do I need full engineering for my wall?
faqs.a: Yes, all structural walls should be designed or verified by a qualified engineer, particularly retaining walls, flood barriers, and high walls. We can work with your engineer or help you connect with one.  # TODO: confirm engineering process

faqs.q: Can the walls be moved or extended later?
faqs.a: Yes. One of the key advantages of modular precast blocks is that they can be dismantled, reconfigured, or extended as your site requirements change.

faqs.q: Are precast block walls suitable for residential properties?
faqs.a: They are a great option for residential retaining walls, garden terraces, driveways, and property boundaries where you want a robust, long-lasting solution.

faqs.q: What kind of site preparation is required?
faqs.a: Most projects only require a compacted, level base capable of supporting the wall loads. Compared with in-situ concrete, site preparation is typically simpler and faster.

faqs.q: Can you work on live commercial or industrial sites?
faqs.a: Yes. Our installation methods are suited to live sites, and we plan deliveries and crane or forklift movements to minimise disruption to your operations.

faqs.q: Do you arrange delivery and cranage of the blocks?
faqs.a: Yes. We coordinate block supply, delivery, and cranage or lifting equipment as part of the installation scope, unless you prefer to manage supply yourself.
Yes, we hold the appropriate construction licences and public liability insurance for the work we perform.  # TODO: insert specific licence classes and policy details once confirmed.

faqs.q: Can you build temporary walls for construction sites?
faqs.a: Yes. Our modular blocks are ideal for temporary construction walls, partitions, and safety barriers that can be removed or reconfigured later.

faqs.q: How do I get a quote?
faqs.a: Call 02 8089 0265 or complete the online quote form with your site location, wall purpose, approximate dimensions, and any plans or photos, and we will get back to you with next steps.
